svg.title: Premium Hi-Fi Music Player — Jetpack Compose UI Specification
svg.desc: A structured visual design specification for an Android premium music player. Intended as a handoff artifact for Claude or another coding agent to implement in Jetpack Compose. Screens: Library, Album, Now Playing + Visualizer, Audio Lab, Parametric EQ, Cloud Sources. Design language: cinematic dark, premium Hi-Fi, restrained lavender accents, 8dp grid, large rounded cards.

g.text: PREMIUM HI-FI PLAYER — UI MASTER SPEC
Implement in Jetpack Compose. Treat IDs below as semantic component names, not literal Android view IDs.
Never sacrifice readability for glass effects
Intensywność 70% Czułość basu 80% Reakcja na beat ✓
Kolory: Z okładki • FPS: 60 • Oszczędzanie baterii: OFF
Brak resamplingu. Dźwięk przekazywany do DAC.
Zmiany EQ powinny być słyszalne natychmiast i mieć funkcję A/B.
Obsłuż: preamp, peak/shelf/bell, Q, gain, frequency, reset.
Cloud source → remoteId → lokalny indeks Room → unified library.
Streaming online + opcjonalne pobranie offline. Nie duplikuj biblioteki.

metadata.implementation:
JETPACK COMPOSE IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT
1. ARCHITECTURE - Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Material 3. - Prefer single-activity architecture with Navigation Compose. - State: ViewModel + StateFlow; UI must be stateless where practical. - Room is the local source of truth for indexed metadata and materialized recommendation tables. - Repository layer abstracts Local, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, NAS/WebDAV. - Media playback should be behind a PlayerRepository / Media3 adapter. - Do not put cloud API calls directly into composables. - Long-running scans/syncs belong in WorkManager. - Use Paging for very large libraries. - Use immutable UI state objects.
2. CORE DOMAIN Track: - id - sourceId - remoteId - uri - title - artist - album - genre - year - durationMs - dateAdded - filenameNormalized - artworkUri - codec - bitDepth - sampleRate - bitrate - isAvailableOffline
PlayEvent: - id - trackId - timestampStart - timestampEnd - playedMs - completed - dayOfWeek - hourOfDay - sourcePlaylistId
SkipEvent: - id - trackId - timestamp - playedMs - dayOfWeek - hourOfDay
TrackAffinity: - trackId - playCount - skipCount - avgCompletionRatio - lastPlayedAt - affinityScore [0..1]
TrackCooccurrence: - trackIdA - trackIdB - count - lastSeenAt
GeneratedMix: - id - seedTrackId - trackIdsOrdered - createdAt
3. NAVIGATION Bottom navigation: - Library - Now Playing - Discover / AI Radio - Settings
Secondary destinations: - Album - Artist - Queue - Audio Lab - Parametric EQ - Visualizer Settings - Cloud Sources - Track Details - Downloads / Offline
4. PLAYER BEHAVIOR - Support gapless playback. - Support queue manipulation. - Support shuffle and repeat modes. - Expose current position and duration as StateFlow. - Persist playback state where useful. - Record PlayEvent when playback starts and finalize it on pause/stop/track change. - completed = true when roughly >=80% is played, but use a configurable threshold. - Record SkipEvent when user skips before completion. - Never block the main thread with audio metadata parsing.
5. VISUALIZER Three modes: A) Ambient: - smooth waveform / halo around album art - reacts to low/mid/high frequency energy - palette can derive from artwork B) Spectrum: - 32–64 frequency bands - logarithmic frequency mapping - beat-reactive amplitude smoothing C) Particle: - particles respond to spectral energy and beat envelope
Controls: - intensity - bass sensitivity - treble sensitivity - animation speed - blur - beat response - palette: artwork/custom/monochrome - FPS: 30/60 - battery saver
Implementation note: - Do not analyze raw PCM on the Compose UI thread. - Prefer Media3 audio effects / an AudioProcessor or dedicated DSP pipeline. - Visualizer state should be sampled/throttled for rendering. - Apply smoothing/attack-release to avoid jitter.
6. AUDIO LAB Show a signal chain: Source → EQ → Crossfade/Gapless → ReplayGain → Output/DAC.
Display: - codec - bit depth - sample rate - bitrate - output device - effective output sample rate - whether resampling is active - whether bit-perfect mode is available/active
Important: - Never claim "bit-perfect" unless the actual Android audio path supports it. - Show "available" vs "active" states separately.
7. PARAMETRIC EQ Data model per band: - enabled - filterType: PEAK, LOW_SHELF, HIGH_SHELF, LOW_PASS, HIGH_PASS - frequencyHz - gainDb - q
Global: - preampDb - enabled - presetName
UI: - graph - draggable nodes - band list - A/B comparison - reset - save preset - headphone profile
8. CLOUD SOURCES Use an adapter interface:
interface MusicSource { val id: String val type: SourceType suspend fun listFiles(path: String): Flow<RemoteTrack> suspend fun openStream(remoteId: String): InputStream suspend fun download(remoteId: String, destination: Uri) suspend fun refresh() }
SourceType: - LOCAL - GOOGLE_DRIVE - ONEDRIVE - DROPBOX - WEBDAV - NAS
Do not make Track.id globally meaningful across providers. Use: - sourceId - remoteId
A cloud file should be indexed once into Room and represented in the unified library.
9. OFFLINE Each track should expose: - ONLINE_ONLY - DOWNLOADING - OFFLINE_AVAILABLE - ERROR
Downloads should be resumable where provider permits. Store files in app-managed storage. Do not expose provider credentials to the playback layer.
10. RECOMMENDATIONS Do not calculate expensive recommendation scores in composables or SQL queries on every screen render. Recompute materialized tables in background.
Initial scoring idea: affinity = normalized(playCount) * completionWeight * recencyWeight * (1 - skipPenalty)
cooccurrence should consider: - count - order - completion - skips - recency - context (hour/day) - source playlist
GeneratedMix: - seed track optional - candidate tracks ranked by affinity + cooccurrence + context - enforce artist/album diversity - avoid recently skipped tracks - avoid immediate repeats - materialize ordered IDs
11. ACCESSIBILITY - Minimum 48dp touch targets. - Respect system font scaling. - Content descriptions for icon-only buttons. - Do not rely only on color. - Provide clear playback state for TalkBack. - Contrast should remain readable over album-art-derived backgrounds.
12. RESPONSIVE TABLET DESIGN Use WindowSizeClass. Phone: - single column - bottom navigation - compact controls
Tablet: - two-pane or three-pane layouts where useful - persistent queue / library rail - larger album art - Audio Lab can use master-detail layout - visualizer can occupy more canvas
13. MOTION - 180–250ms standard transitions. - 300–500ms for album-art palette transitions. - Use spring animation for play/pause and visualizer controls. - Avoid infinite animations when app is backgrounded. - Pause visualizer when not visible to reduce battery consumption.
14. UI PRINCIPLE The product must feel like a premium Hi-Fi instrument, not a Spotify clone. Prioritize: - hierarchy - album artwork - audio quality information - tactile playback controls - fast navigation - user ownership of local/cloud music - no ads - no unnecessary gamification
